features: TOUCHES THE DATABASE: NEW COLUMNS AND TABLES, NO DATA REWRITTEN — Four new migrations, which the update runs by itself, and two of the settings. The balances table (saldi) gets four more columns: the financial year the carried-over debt you declare comes from, what you declared, who declared it and when. Six new tables: three for the assembly's exemptions from acting within six months (dispense_sei_mesi and the two that link it to financial years and people), two for repayment agreements (accordi_rientro and accordo_rientro_rate) and one for letter templates (modelli_testo). The print settings get six new fields for the practice: name, address, town, email, certified email (PEC) and telephone. It rewrites no data: the balances recorded before keep their origin as not declared and no recorded figure changes. Each migration checks what is already there: if it stops halfway it resumes from where it got to. One calculation changes: the delay and the band of a carried-over debt with no declared origin, in the Treasury and in the «Rate scadute» list (see below). No new permission, no new library, the requirements do not change. To send the letters by email the mail server must be set up in the settings; without it the letters are printed. After the update, reload the pages that are already open.

CHANGES: THE MOVEMENTS MENU HAS A NEW ENTRY, AND FITS ON ONE ROW — The new entry «Rate scadute» (overdue instalments) is next to «Incassi». So that the nine entries with icons fit on one row, three have a short name: «Incassi» (before «Incassi rate», instalment payments), «Fatture» (before «Fatture passive», purchase invoices) and «Pagamenti» (before «Pagamenti fornitori», supplier payments). The full name stays in the page title, on mouse hover and in the dropdown. If the window is too narrow, the row scrolls sideways inside the menu instead of wrapping, without scrolling the page.

CHANGES: THE TREASURY DOES NOT PROMISE REMINDERS AND LEADS TO THE LIST — The red tag «Rischio ingiunzione» (injunction risk) now says «Liquidità insufficiente» (insufficient liquidity). The action «Verifica o Sollecita Incassi» (check or chase payments), which led to the list of payments and promised a reminder the program did not prepare, is called «Vedi le rate scadute» (see the overdue instalments) and leads to the «Rate scadute» list; its description says: «Chi deve ancora pagare, persona per persona: prima di scrivere, registra i versamenti già arrivati in banca» (who still has to pay, person by person: before writing, record the payments that have already reached the bank). Under the first five people in arrears there is always «Vedi tutte le rate scadute» (see all overdue instalments), even with the green light. A carried-over debt whose age the program does not know is no longer «in ritardo di N giorni» (N days late): before, it took the due date of the first instalment of the plan, and a debt from 2023 could appear a few days late; the line now says «c'è un pregresso di anzianità non nota» (there is a carried-over debt of unknown age) and, if the person also has instalments with days, «ritardo massimo noto: N giorni; c'è un pregresso di anzianità non nota» (longest known delay: N days; …). The traffic light and the amounts of the forecast do not change; the band of that carried-over debt does: it goes into «oltre 90 giorni» (over 90 days).

CHANGES: THE TEXTS THAT SPOKE OF REMINDERS AND «MOROSITÀ» WITHOUT THE PROGRAM DOING THEM — The page of the instalment payments («Incassi») said «Il debito residuo rimarrà aperto e tracciato per i futuri solleciti» (the remaining debt will stay open and tracked for future reminders): it now says that the remainder stays open and is found among the instalments falling due and, after the due date, among the overdue ones. The page of the debt to a supplier was titled «Gestione Morosità» (arrears management) and promised a cross-check with the residents' balances that does not exist: it now says that it concerns only the debt to the supplier and points to the «Rate scadute» list. The schedule task «Deficit Cassa Ereditato» (the inherited debt of a supplier, uncovered) has the button «Vedi le rate scadute», which leads to the list, in place of «Gestisci Morosità»; tasks already created keep the earlier label. The warning that the account would go negative, when paying an invoice, says «di scrivere a chi ha rate scadute» (to write to whoever has overdue instalments) instead of «sollecitare i morosi» (chasing the defaulters) and has the link «Vedi le rate scadute». The balance sheet page and its PDF point to the «Rate scadute» page instead of saying that the list per unit is coming; the invoices guide says «Pagamenti» and not «Pagamenti fornitori». In the portal, the carried-over debt (instalment 0) not yet issued says «In attesa di emissione» (awaiting issue), like the other instalments not yet issued, and no longer «Debito pregresso». The description of the mail settings no longer speaks of «comunicazioni ufficiali» (official communications).

CHANGES: THE PRINTOUTS SAY THE DAY OF WHOEVER ADMINISTERS — «Documento emesso il …» (document issued on), «Stampato il …» (printed on) and «Data di stampa» (print date) used to take the server's day, which between midnight and one in the morning in Rome (two in summer) is still the day before: a printout made at half past midnight on 1 January said 31 December. Now it is the day and time of whoever administers. It applies to «Documento emesso il …» at the foot of every printout that carries it, and to «Stampato il …» and «Data di stampa» of the general journal, the ledger, the account detail, the payment slip, a person's statement, the statement of accessory charges, the accounting register and the balance sheet. A printout that carries its own date (for example a printout at a past date) keeps it.

CHANGES: THE RECEIPTS PAGE SAYS «CONSEGNA NON PROVATA» AND COUNTS ONLY RECEIPTS — A receipt sent by email now says «Inviata il … a …, consegna non provata» (sent on … to …, delivery not proved): the mail server accepted it, whether it arrived the program does not know. The limit of ten messages in the last minute to addresses typed by hand, which also applies to the letters, says «dieci messaggi» (ten messages) and no longer «dieci ricevute» (ten receipts). The warning «in coda da più di un'ora» (in the queue for more than an hour) on the receipts page counts only receipts: a letter in the queue is not a receipt in the queue. If you cancel a payment for which only the compensation notice had gone out, it appears among those to communicate with the word «avviso» (notice) (there is no receipt, and «Non serve comunicarla», it need not be communicated, works).

NEW: «RATE SCADUTE», ONE ROW PER PERSON — In the condominium's movements menu. For each person: the overdue amount (the credit is shown beside it and not subtracted: the Treasury can give a lower figure because it subtracts it, and the page says so), the bands 1–30, 31–90 and over 90 days, the oldest delay, the nearest of the six-month dates with the exemption if there is one, the last letter and, if there is one, the mark of the repayment agreement; opening the row shows the person's instalments. Whoever has several units (a flat and a garage) has a single row. You filter by person, band, minimum amount (typed in euros), management, carried-over debt, «Data dei sei mesi entro (giorni)» (the six-month date within … days), letters and agreement; the order is by overdue amount or by the six-month date. You can choose a past day, for the assembly (then the credit is not there), and the view «In scadenza nei prossimi N giorni» (falling due in the next N days), for the reminders. Above the list a line counts the instalments whose due date has passed but that are not yet issued and the balances not yet in an approved plan: they are not in this list and are not added to the overdue amount. The filters are not remembered, like in the other pages; the number of rows per page can be chosen and is remembered, like in the other tables. «Seleziona tutte le N dei filtri» (select all N of the filters) takes all the people of the filters, including those of other pages. The list is printed as a landscape PDF, without a signature, with the line saying that it contains personal data and must not be put on the notice board; above the number of people the server can print it goes back to the list and tells you to narrow the filters.

NEW: THE TWO SIX-MONTH DATES AND THE ASSEMBLY'S EXEMPTION — For each overdue instalment the page shows two dates, and highlights the nearest among those without an exemption: six months from the end of the financial year in which the instalment falls due, and six months from the end of the financial year the plan belongs to (for an extraordinary plan, the year of the resolution). They are a calculation, without judgements: no words like «termine scaduto» (deadline expired). Where it cannot be done, the cell says so: in January the financial year of the due date does not exist yet («la data si calcola quando chiudi l'esercizio 2026 e apri il successivo»: the date is calculated when you close the year 2026 and open the next, for example); if two years contain the date, the nearest is shown with a mark; if the carried-over debt has no origin, «Origine non dichiarata: le date non si calcolano.» (origin not declared: the dates are not calculated). If the date falls on a holiday the program does not move it: it is a prudent choice, the earliest date, and that the law moves it to the next day is not established. The page «Dispense dei sei mesi» (six-month exemptions), opened from the list of financial years, records the resolution by which the assembly exempted from acting: the date (not after today), the number and the file of the minutes (optional), the years covered, all the people or only some (no answer already chosen), a note; and the revocation. The exemption is shown beside the date it covers, and the dates do not change.

NEW: THE ORIGIN OF THE CARRIED-OVER DEBT — In the form of a debit balance there is the optional field «Origine del pregresso» (origin of the carried-over debt), with no answer already chosen: a financial year of the condominium, «Dovuto con questo piano» (due with this plan) or «Prima del primo esercizio» (before the first year). For the balances already written there is «Dichiara l'origine» (declare the origin), also on a balance locked in an issued plan (it does not touch the amount or the lock) and for the lines of a handover, and «Dichiara l'origine del pregresso, in blocco» (declare the origin, in bulk) from the balances page; who declared it and when stays recorded; «Togli l'origine» (remove the origin) brings it back to «non dichiarata». The program never deduces it. With a year, the two six-month dates start from the end of that year, but the program writes no number of days (the carried-over debt goes into the band «oltre 90 giorni», over 90 days); with «Dovuto con questo piano» the days and the dates count as for an instalment; with no origin the line says «pregresso con origine non dichiarata — dichiarala dai saldi» (carried-over debt with origin not declared, declare it from the balances) and the dates are not calculated. If the same share has several balances, the oldest origin counts; one balance without an origin is enough for the whole share to be «non dichiarata». The import from the manual template reads the optional column «esercizio» of the balances (the year or the name of the financial year); a file from before, without the column, is read as before; if the year written is not among those of the condominium, the balance goes in with the origin not declared and a check after the import says so.

NEW: THE LETTERS TO THE RESIDENTS — Reminder, chaser, formal demand and formal notice, from the «Rate scadute» list («Prepara le lettere a tutte le N», prepare the letters to all N, to the selected ones or to a single one) and from a person's statement («Prepara una lettera», prepare a letter). You choose the type at every sending and it is not remembered: the window proposes the chaser (the reminder from the view «In scadenza», falling due) and never the formal demand or the formal notice. The program never says of a person that they are «diffidata» (formally warned) or «in mora» (in default): the letter carries the name of the type you chose. Reminder (for instalments falling due) and chaser go by email from the program, are printed or downloaded as one PDF per person; formal demand and formal notice are printed or downloaded, and do not go by email. The letter has at the top the practice (name, address, email, PEC and telephone, which you write in «Impostazioni → Stampe» (settings, printouts)) and the condominium, the instalments with unit, due date, remainder and days late (in the «Ritardo» column, delay, «N giorni» (N days), and for a carried-over debt without days «pregresso dell'esercizio 2025» (carried over from year 2025) or «pregresso di esercizi precedenti» (carried over from earlier years)), the total, «Situazione al …» (situation as at …; payments recorded afterwards are not included), the deadline for payment (a number of days from receipt, a date, or no deadline), the condominium's IBAN (with several accounts you choose) and, for formal demand and formal notice, the space for the handwritten signature. The text starts from the template last used for that type, or from the program's own, neutral for formal demand and formal notice (no articles of law, interest or costs; it says that the condominium «potrà procedere al recupero del credito», may proceed to recover the debt; the window says to check it), and is changed at every sending; the person's credit is not in the letter, but the preview tells you who has one. The place before the date is the practice's town, or the condominium's if there is none; replies to the letters sent by email arrive at the practice's email.

NEW: BEFORE SENDING YOU SEE WHO RECEIVES WHAT — The preview shows, person by person, the channel (email, print or PDF per person), the addresses, who is left without and who has only the PEC (the PEC goes as a simple email, if you tick it); you can remove a person. «Vedi il PDF» (see the PDF) shows the letters with the word ANTEPRIMA (preview), without issuing them; for emails, «Mandane una a me» (send me one) sends you the message of the first person, with the word PROVA (test). The sending goes only to the people you saw: the window tells you who entered the filters after that. Chaser emails go at most 200 letters at a time, and printing and the .zip at most 200: beyond that, the sentence says to choose a page of the list and move to the next, and «Invia le altre» (send the others) sends the rest. An email goes only if the debt is still the one in the letter: if between queueing and departure you recorded a payment, or an agreement covers the instalment, or the issue was cancelled, the message does not go and the line says «Il debito della lettera è cambiato prima dell'invio: rivedila e mandala di nuovo» (the debt of the letter changed before sending: review it and send it again). «Rifalla con le cifre di oggi» (redo it with today's figures: in the list, for the email letters that did not go) and «Invia di nuovo, con le cifre di oggi» (send again, with today's figures: in the person's register) redo the letter with today's figures, in a new line; the earlier one stays. The limit of ten messages a minute to addresses typed by hand applies.

NEW: THE LETTER REGISTER, THE POSTING AND THE PROOF — In the person's statement, «Lettere» (letters): each letter with the type, the date, the channel, the state (in the queue, sent, printed, posted, did not go), who issued it, the total of then and today's remainder of the same instalments. The PDF of chaser, formal demand and formal notice is kept as it went out (the reminder is not) and is reopened from here. After printing or the .zip: «Registra la spedizione» (record the posting) with the way (registered mail with return receipt, PEC sent outside the program, by hand, ordinary mail, other), the date, the number or details and a note, also for several letters together; «Allega la prova» (attach the proof) (PDF, image, .eml or .p7m, up to 10 MB: the scan of the registered-mail receipt, the PEC receipts); the proof can be removed while the financial year of the letter is open, and who removed it stays recorded. A letter sent by email says «consegna non provata» (delivery not proved); a printed one says «spedizione non registrata» (posting not recorded) until you record it. In the list, «Nessuna lettera negli ultimi (giorni)» (no letter in the last … days) and «Mai scritto (contano le lettere partite o spedite)» (never written to; letters that went or were posted count) count only the letters that went by email or whose posting you recorded: a letter only printed or downloaded, or in the queue, or that did not go, does not count; the filter «Stampate o scaricate, spedizione da registrare» (printed or downloaded, posting to be recorded) finds them.

NEW: THE LETTER TEMPLATES — «Impostazioni → Stampe → Modelli delle lettere» (settings, printouts, letter templates): the texts you write often, for one type of letter, for all the condominiums or for one only. In the letter window the «Modello» menu starts from the last one used for that type in that condominium; the text is filled with the fields (name, total, deadline, condominium) and stays editable for that sending. «Salva come modello…» (save as template) creates one from the text you wrote, choosing which condominiums it is valid for; «Aggiorna» (update) changes a template, and if it is valid for all the window says so. The program's own texts are not changed: they are duplicated. Changing or deleting a template does not change the letters already written, and a letter remembers the template it came from. Whoever does not manage the print settings sees the templates and uses them, but does not save them. If the condominium's name already begins with «Condominio» or «Supercondominio», the title does not put the word in front of it and the text does not repeat it («del Condominio Le Rose», «del Supercondominio Le Torri»).

NEW: THE REPAYMENT AGREEMENT, AS A REGISTER — From the row of the list, «Registra un accordo di rientro» (record a repayment agreement) with a person: the date of the agreement, «fino al» (until: the date of the last instalment), the instalments it covers, each with the recognised part (not above the remainder of that day), «autorizzato dall'assemblea» (authorised by the assembly) yes or no, with no answer already chosen (with the date and the minutes if yes; «registra l'autorizzazione» if it arrives later), a note and the scan of the agreement. It is closed with a date and a note; it is not deleted. The covered instalments stay in the list, because they are overdue, with the mark «Accordo di rientro del …, fino al …: riconosciuti € …, oggi € …» (repayment agreement of …, until …: recognised € …, today € …) or «… riconosciuti € …, residuo invariato dal …» (… recognised € …, remainder unchanged since …). The proposed letters do not ask for the recognised part of an instalment (€ 200.00 covered out of € 500.00 leave € 300.00 in the letter); the preview says so and you can put it back. After «fino al» the instalments come back into the letters and the mark says «(data passata)» (date passed). If the person pays more than is owed on those instalments (for example interest and costs), the extra part goes to their credit: the agreement shows it («Versati € … oltre il capitale riconosciuto», paid € … above the recognised capital), in the page and in the statement. The filter «Con accordo di rientro» finds them. A person with an agreement cannot be deleted, and recalculating a plan keeps the covered instalments, if the new plan has an instalment with the same number.

NEW: THE COMPENSATION NOTICE — In the receipts page, «Compensazioni senza avviso» (compensations without notice): the payments in which the credit covered the instalments of a person who does not receive the receipt of that payment (a payment made only with credit has no receipt; who paid for someone else and used the position's credit). You choose the compensations, the period and the management are those of the page filters, and you print or email the notice to the person whose instalment was covered: «Il … il suo credito è stato usato per le rate qui sotto, senza un versamento nuovo» (on …, their credit was used for the instalments below, with no new payment), with the total and the stamp duty of your choice. A notice that did not go returns among the compensations without notice. The notice names whose credit it was, if it belonged to another person of the same payment.

HOW IT WORKS TODAY, WHERE IT MAKES A DIFFERENCE — (1) The two six-month dates are a calculation of the program, not a legal assessment: the text of article 1129, paragraph 9, is beside them, and deciding whether to act is yours. (2) The repayment agreement is a register: it has no calendar and no forfeiture, never says «in regola» (in order) or «decaduto» (forfeited), and the Treasury and the portal do not know it (the Treasury counts the person's overdue amount as expected). Interest and costs have no place: if the person pays them beyond the debt of the instalments, they end up in their credit. (3) The starting text of formal demand and formal notice is the program's and neutral (no articles of law, interest or costs; formal demand and formal notice differ only in tone): a formal demand or a formal notice has legal effects, check it before sending. (4) A simple email has no delivery receipt; the PEC that leaves the program is a simple email; the posting and the proof you record yourself. (5) A letter by email goes out with the figures of that moment and does not go if the debt changes; a printed one does not: what you print is today's debt, and the line «Situazione al …» says so. (6) A carried-over debt with no declared origin, or with a year, has no number of days: it sits in the band «oltre 90» (over 90) and the line says «c'è un pregresso di anzianità non nota» (there is a carried-over debt of unknown age), preceded by «ritardo massimo noto: N giorni;» (longest known delay: N days) if there are also instalments with days. (7) The compensation notice has printing and email, with no preview window, no .zip and no «Mandane una a me». (8) The name of a template must be different, by type and by «vale per» (valid for), from the existing ones (upper or lower case does not count).
